evidence.dom: 『The concrete and aggregates industry is highly fragmented, with numerous participants』+『No single customer accounted for more than 10% of...segment revenue』→骨材/生コンは断片化。一方セメントは輸送経済(50mi)で地域寡占。総合で寡占=70
evidence.irr: 『producers of concrete and aggregates typically can profitably sell their products only in areas within 50 miles of their production facilities. There are high barriers to entry』→輸送コストで地域供給が守られる高摩擦=70(コモディティだが地理的移行困難)
evidence.rep: 『high barriers to entry for new aggregates production facilities located near major metropolitan markets, including environmental permitting requirements』→都市近接骨材鉱区は許認可で複製困難だがコモディティ生産自体は資本で追随可=困難60
evidence.dur: 『high barriers to entry...environmental permitting requirements』+『within 50 miles of their production facilities』→堀の性質は規制(環境許認可)+物理(埋蔵量・輸送経済)=100。循環性はp2/f5で捕捉
evidence.erosion: 『Our market share remained relatively flat in fiscal 2026 compared with fiscal 2025』→侵食なし=none
evidence.disrupt: 蝕セクションは市場シェア横ばいのみ、破壊系キーワードのヒットなし。セメント/骨材/石膏ボードに技術代替なし=settled
evidence.expiry: 限セクション『(ヒットなし)』。コンセッション・特許束依存ではなく自社保有鉱区=期限型独占なし=no
evidence.moatdecay: 『market share remained relatively flat』+『high barriers to entry』→堀の劣化なし=no
evidence.geopol: 『approximately 65% of our total revenue...is generated in 10 states』(全て米国内)+『single supplier』for synthetic gypsum/slag(byproducts)→米国内集中・原料単一供給はあるが対外地政学リスク軽微=0
evidence.p2: 『Demand for our products is generally cyclical and seasonal』+『A majority of our revenue is from customers who are in industries...that are cyclical...many of our customers operate in the construction industry』→住宅建設依存の深循環
evidence.p4: 『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness』=監査手続の定型文(実指摘ではない)+『There are no unresolved Staff comments』→無限定・accr<0で90
evidence.f3: R&D該当なし業態(コモディティ)+『Our market share remained relatively flat in fiscal 2026』→両符号非正=55。顧客集中は『No single customer...more than 10%』で悪化なし(-10不適用)
